requirement: The system shall prevent checkout when any item in the basket has a quantity greater than the stock currently available.
The system shall compute the order total as the sum of line item prices, apply any active promotional discount, and add the shipping charge for the destination.
The customer adds an item to the basket; the system checks availability, reserves it for fifteen minutes and shows the updated basket.
The customer enters a promotion code at checkout; the system validates it is active and applicable to the basket, then displays the reduced total.
As a customer, I want to view my order history so that I can track previous purchases and re-order items.
As an operations analyst, I want to export a daily report of orders paid but not yet shipped so that I can chase fulfilment delays.
An order may only be cancelled by the customer within thirty minutes of placement, or by staff at any time before dispatch.
Every payment attempt for an order, successful or failed, must be recorded for later reconciliation.
The order table shall guarantee that the paid amount is never negative and that shipped orders always carry a tracking number.

-- order header table for the storefront
CREATE TABLE customer_order (
    order_id        BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id     VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    placed_at       TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    subtotal        NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    discount        NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    shipping        NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    total           NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    tracking_no     VARCHAR(60),
    CONSTRAINT order_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('PLACED','PAID','PICKING','SHIPPED','DELIVERED','CANCELLED')),
    CONSTRAINT total_not_negative CHECK (total >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT shipped_needs_tracking CHECK (
        status <> 'SHIPPED' OR tracking_no IS NOT NULL
    )
);

CREATE INDEX order_customer_idx ON customer_order (customer_id, placed_at DESC);

-- order line table
CREATE TABLE order_line (
    line_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id     BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    sku          VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    quantity     INTEGER       NOT NULL,
    unit_price   NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT line_order_fk FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES customer_order(order_id),
    CONSTRAINT line_qty_positive CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT line_price_nonneg CHECK (unit_price >= 0)
);
-- payment attempts table
CREATE TABLE payment_attempt (
    attempt_id     BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id       BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    provider_ref   VARCHAR(80),
    outcome        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    failure_reason VARCHAR(200),
    attempted_at   TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT payment_outcome_chk CHECK (outcome IN ('AUTHORISED','DECLINED','ERROR'))
);

requirement: The customer shall never see another customer's order details, even when guessing order identifiers.
The storefront search shall return products matching the query in either the title or the description, paginated ten per page.
